questions.help_zh: 沒有量到那麼高的話，請選「沒有」。
questions.help_en: If you have never measured that high, choose No.

rules.reason_zh: 血壓很高又有這些症狀，可能很危急，請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: Very high blood pressure with these symptoms can be an emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有突然停過這類藥，或超過幾天沒吃？
questions.label_en: Recently, did you stop this medicine suddenly or go several days without it?

rules.reason_zh: 前陣子有一段時間沒吃這類藥，血壓與心跳可能受影響，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: You went without this medicine for a while, which can affect blood pressure and heart rate; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有覺得心跳特別慢、很容易喘或很容易累？
questions.label_en: Does your pulse feel very slow, or do you get breathless or tired very easily?

rules.reason_zh: 心跳過慢或容易喘，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: A very slow pulse or easy breathlessness; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有新的喘鳴聲或氣喘發作變多？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had new wheezing or more asthma attacks?

rules.reason_zh: 乙型阻斷劑可能讓氣喘惡化，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: Beta blockers can worsen asthma; please visit first.

monitoring.label_zh: 居家血壓量測紀錄（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Home blood pressure log (date of latest check)
monitoring.reason_zh: 血壓控制穩定時，台灣指引建議約每 3 個月檢視一次居家血壓；超過這段時間沒量，請先補量。
monitoring.reason_en: When blood pressure is controlled, the Taiwan guideline suggests checking home blood pressure about every 3 months; if it has been longer, please measure again first.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 hydrochlorothiazide、indapamide）幫助排水降血壓，要留意脫水、抽筋、血鈉血鉀偏低與痛風。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as hydrochlorothiazide and indapamide) remove fluid to lower blood pressure. Watch for dehydration, cramps, low sodium or potassium, and gout.

questions.label_zh: 最近一週在家量血壓，早晚平均的收縮壓（上面的數字）是多少？
questions.label_en: Over the past week at home, what is your average systolic (top) blood pressure?
questions.help_zh: 請照「722」方式量：連續 7 天，早晚各量 2 次，每次量 2 回，再取平均。
questions.help_en: Use the 722 method: 7 days, morning and evening, 2 readings each time, then average.

rules.reason_zh: 沒有居家血壓數字，請醫師確認血壓控制情形。
rules.reason_en: No home blood pressure was given; the doctor should check blood pressure control.

rules.reason_zh: 收縮壓高於 180 mmHg 屬於危險的高血壓，續藥前請先就醫。
rules.reason_en: Systolic above 180 mmHg is dangerously high; please be seen before any renewal.

rules.reason_zh: 收縮壓低於 90 mmHg 屬於低血壓，請醫師確認用藥。
rules.reason_en: Systolic below 90 mmHg counts as low blood pressure; the doctor should review the medicine.

rules.reason_zh: 居家平均收縮壓 130 mmHg 以上，高於台灣高血壓指引的目標（低於 130/80），請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Average home systolic is 130 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 同一段時間，早晚平均的舒張壓（下面的數字）是多少？
questions.label_en: Over the same time, what is your average diastolic (bottom) blood pressure?

rules.reason_zh: 沒有居家血壓數字，請醫師確認血壓控制情形。
rules.reason_en: No home blood pressure was given; the doctor should check blood pressure control.

rules.reason_zh: 舒張壓高於 120 mmHg 屬於危險的高血壓，續藥前請先就醫。
rules.reason_en: Diastolic above 120 mmHg is dangerously high; please be seen before any renewal.

rules.reason_zh: 舒張壓低於 60 mmHg 屬於低血壓，請醫師確認用藥。
rules.reason_en: Diastolic below 60 mmHg counts as low blood pressure; the doctor should review the medicine.

rules.reason_zh: 居家平均舒張壓 80 mmHg 以上，高於台灣高血壓指引的目標（低於 130/80），請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Average home diastolic is 80 mmHg or higher, above the Taiwan guideline target (below 130/80); the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 站起來的時候，會不會頭暈、眼前發黑，或差點跌倒？
questions.label_en: When you stand up, do you get dizzy, see black, or nearly fall?

rules.reason_zh: 可能是血壓太低或體位性低血壓，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Possible low blood pressure on standing; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有昏倒過？
questions.label_en: Have you fainted recently?

rules.reason_zh: 昏倒的原因要先查清楚，續藥前請先回診。
rules.reason_en: The cause of fainting needs to be found first; please visit before renewal.

questions.label_zh: 血壓很高的時候（超過 180/120），有沒有同時出現劇烈頭痛、胸痛、呼吸困難、視力改變、手腳無力或意識不清？
questions.label_en: When your blood pressure is very high (above 180/120), have you also had severe headache, chest pain, trouble breathing, vision changes, weakness or confusion?
questions.help_zh: 沒有量到那麼高的話，請選「沒有」。
questions.help_en: If you have never measured that high, choose No.

rules.reason_zh: 血壓很高又有這些症狀，可能很危急，請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: Very high blood pressure with these symptoms can be an emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子，或吃喝很少、脫水的情形？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had bad vomiting or diarrhoea, or eaten and drunk very little, or become dehydrated?

rules.reason_zh: 嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子或吃喝很少時，身體容易缺水，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: With severe vomiting, diarrhoea or very little eating and drinking you can become dehydrated; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有常常抽筋、全身無力，或心跳不規律？
questions.label_en: Do you often get cramps or feel weak all over, or notice an irregular heartbeat?

rules.reason_zh: 抽筋、無力或心律不整可能是電解質失衡，請先回診抽血。
rules.reason_en: Cramps, weakness or an irregular heartbeat may mean an electrolyte imbalance; please visit for blood tests.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有痛風發作，例如腳趾、腳踝突然紅腫痛？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had a gout attack, such as a suddenly red, swollen, painful toe or ankle?

rules.reason_zh: 利尿劑可能讓尿酸升高，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Diuretics can raise uric acid; the doctor should review.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能與血鉀（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function and potassium (date of latest blood test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 指引對慢性腎臟病患者建議至少每年檢查一次腎功能；本系統對這類藥沿用相同間隔，這是保守的設定，最後由醫師決定。
monitoring.reason_en: KDIGO advises checking kidney function at least yearly in people with CKD; this tool applies the same interval to this class as a conservative setting, and the doctor makes the final call.

monitoring.label_zh: 居家血壓量測紀錄（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Home blood pressure log (date of latest check)
monitoring.reason_zh: 血壓控制穩定時，台灣指引建議約每 3 個月檢視一次居家血壓；超過這段時間沒量，請先補量。
monitoring.reason_en: When blood pressure is controlled, the Taiwan guideline suggests checking home blood pressure about every 3 months; if it has been longer, please measure again first.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥幫助降低壞膽固醇、減少心血管事件；要留意肌肉痠痛無力、茶色尿與肝功能。
classes.summary_en: These medicines lower LDL cholesterol and reduce heart and vessel events. Watch for muscle pain or weakness, dark urine and yellow skin or eyes.

questions.label_zh: 肌肉痛或無力到走不動，或尿量變得非常少？
questions.label_en: Is your muscle pain or weakness so bad that you cannot walk, or is your urine output very low?

rules.reason_zh: 肌肉嚴重疼痛或無力，加上尿量很少，需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫，並告訴醫師您在吃這個藥。
rules.reason_en: Severe muscle pain or weakness with very little urine needs immediate attention. Seek care now and tell the doctor which medicine you take.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有不明原因的肌肉痠痛、無力或抽痛，尤其是大腿或肩膀？
questions.label_en: Do you have unexplained muscle pain, weakness or cramps, especially in the thighs or shoulders?

rules.reason_zh: 肌肉症狀可能與 statin 有關，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Muscle symptoms may be related to the statin; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 肌肉痠痛時，尿液有沒有變成茶色或可樂色？
questions.label_en: With muscle pain, has your urine turned tea- or cola-coloured?

rules.reason_zh: 肌肉痠痛加上茶色尿，需要先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: Muscle pain with dark urine needs tests; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有皮膚或眼白變黃、右上腹痛，或食慾變很差？
questions.label_en: Do you have yellow skin or eyes, pain in the upper right belly, or a much poorer appetite?

rules.reason_zh: 皮膚或眼白變黃、右上腹痛，需要先回診檢查。
rules.reason_en: Yellow skin or eyes or upper right belly pain needs tests; please visit first.

monitoring.label_zh: 血脂檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Lipid panel (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: ACC/AHA 指引建議開始用藥或處方改變後 4 至 12 週檢查血脂，之後依需要每 3 至 12 個月一次；超過 12 個月沒檢查就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: ACC/AHA advise a lipid check 4 to 12 weeks after starting a statin or after a prescription change, then every 3 to 12 months as needed; no check in over 12 months goes to the doctor.

classes.summary_zh: Metformin 是常用的第一線口服降血糖藥；腎功能不好的人有使用限制；要留意腸胃不適，以及突然很喘、肌肉痠痛、異常疲倦等警訊。
classes.summary_en: Metformin is a common first-line oral diabetes medicine. People with poor kidney function have limits on its use; watch for stomach upset and for warning signs such as sudden breathlessness, muscle pain or unusual tiredness.

questions.label_zh: 現在有沒有意識模糊、抽搐，或血糖太高或太低，需要別人幫忙處理？
questions.label_en: Right now, are you confused, having a seizure, or with blood sugar so high or low that you need someone to help you?

rules.reason_zh: 請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: This may be a blood sugar emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有持續的噁心、腹瀉或胃不舒服，是開始吃這類藥之後才有的？
questions.label_en: Do you have lasting nausea, diarrhoea or stomach upset since starting this type of medicine?

rules.reason_zh: 持續的腸胃不適，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Lasting stomach upset; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近有沒有嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子，或吃喝很少、脫水的情形？
questions.label_en: Recently, have you had bad vomiting or diarrhoea, or eaten and drunk very little, or become dehydrated?

rules.reason_zh: 嚴重嘔吐、拉肚子或吃喝很少時，身體容易缺水，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: With severe vomiting, diarrhoea or very little eating and drinking you can become dehydrated; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 近期有沒有安排打顯影劑的檢查（例如電腦斷層）或手術？
questions.label_en: Do you have a scan with contrast dye (such as a CT) or surgery coming up?

rules.reason_zh: 要做顯影劑檢查或手術，請醫師確認用藥安排。
rules.reason_en: A contrast scan or surgery is coming up; the doctor should review your medicine plan.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有突然很喘、肌肉痠痛、很想吐、肚子痛，或異常疲倦？
questions.label_en: Do you have sudden breathlessness, muscle pain, nausea, belly pain or unusual tiredness?

rules.reason_zh: 突然很喘、肌肉痠痛、噁心、肚子痛或異常疲倦，需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫，並告訴醫師您在吃這個藥。
rules.reason_en: Sudden breathlessness, muscle pain, nausea, belly pain or unusual tiredness need immediate attention. Seek care now and tell the doctor you take this medicine.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能 eGFR（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function eGFR (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: eGFR 低於 30，需要先回診讓醫師評估用藥。
rules.reason_en: eGFR is below 30; a visit is needed so the doctor can assess your medicine.

rules.reason_zh: eGFR 低於 45，請醫師評估用藥。
rules.reason_en: eGFR is below 45; the doctor should assess your medicine.

monitoring.reason_zh: 使用 metformin 的人至少每年檢查一次 eGFR，高風險者要更頻繁。
monitoring.reason_en: People on metformin should have eGFR checked at least yearly, more often if at higher risk.

monitoring.label_zh: 糖化血色素 HbA1c（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: HbA1c (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: 糖化血色素 7% 以上，高於多數成人的目標（低於 7%），請醫師確認；目標值會因人而異。
rules.reason_en: HbA1c is 7% or higher, above the target for many adults (below 7%); the doctor should review. Targets can be individualised.

monitoring.reason_zh: 血糖穩定時至少每年檢查兩次，因此超過約半年沒有數值就請醫師看。
monitoring.reason_en: At least twice a year when stable, so a value older than about six months goes to the doctor.

monitoring.label_zh: 腎功能 eGFR（最近一次抽血日期）
monitoring.label_en: Kidney function eGFR (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的腎功能與尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists kidney function and urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 尿液白蛋白／肌酸酐比值 UACR（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 散瞳眼底檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Dilated eye exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 列出糖尿病患者每年做一次散瞳眼底檢查（沒有病變且血糖達標時，可考慮 1 至 2 年一次，由醫師決定）。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists an annual dilated eye exam for people with diabetes (every 1-2 years may be considered when there is no retinopathy and goals are met; the doctor decides).

monitoring.label_zh: 完整足部檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Comprehensive foot exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 建議糖尿病患者至少每年做一次完整的足部檢查。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA recommends a comprehensive foot exam at least once a year.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -gliptin 結尾）單獨使用時較少造成低血糖，要留意嚴重的上腹痛、關節痛與皮膚水泡。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -gliptin) rarely cause low blood sugar on their own. Watch for severe upper belly pain, joint pain and skin blisters.

rules.reason_zh: 請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: This may be a blood sugar emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有嚴重、持續不退的上腹痛，可能伴隨嘔吐？
questions.label_en: Do you have severe, lasting upper belly pain, possibly with vomiting?

rules.reason_zh: 嚴重又持續的上腹痛，需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫，並告訴醫師您在吃這個藥。
rules.reason_en: Severe, lasting upper belly pain needs immediate attention. Seek care now and tell the doctor you take this medicine.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有新的嚴重關節痛，痛到影響活動？
questions.label_en: Do you have new severe joint pain that limits your activity?

rules.reason_zh: 嚴重關節痛是這類藥已知的副作用，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Severe joint pain is a known side effect of this class; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 皮膚有沒有出現水泡或大片脫皮？
questions.label_en: Do you have blisters or large areas of peeling skin?

rules.reason_zh: 皮膚出現水泡，請先回診。
rules.reason_en: Skin blisters may be a drug reaction; please visit first.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有新的腿腫、躺下會喘，或體重短時間內明顯增加？
questions.label_en: Do you have new leg swelling, breathlessness lying down, or quick weight gain?

rules.reason_zh: 新的腿腫、躺下會喘或體重快速增加，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: New leg swelling, breathlessness lying down or quick weight gain; please visit first.

monitoring.label_zh: 糖化血色素 HbA1c（最近一次數值）
monitoring.label_en: HbA1c (latest value)

rules.reason_zh: 糖化血色素 7% 以上，高於多數成人的目標（低於 7%），請醫師確認；目標值會因人而異。

monitoring.label_en: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (date of latest test)
monitoring.reason_zh: 糖尿病患者的尿液白蛋白檢查，ADA 建議每年至少一次。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA lists urine albumin testing at least yearly for people with diabetes.

monitoring.label_zh: 散瞳眼底檢查（最近一次日期）
monitoring.label_en: Dilated eye exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 列出糖尿病患者每年做一次散瞳眼底檢查（沒有病變且血糖達標時，可考慮 1 至 2 年一次，由醫師決定）。

monitoring.label_en: Comprehensive foot exam (date of latest exam)
monitoring.reason_zh: ADA 建議糖尿病患者至少每年做一次完整的足部檢查。
monitoring.reason_en: The ADA recommends a comprehensive foot exam at least once a year.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（名稱常以 -gliflozin 結尾）讓糖分從尿液排出；要留意生殖器與泌尿道感染、脫水，以及噁心嘔吐、肚子痛、極度疲倦或呼吸急促等警訊。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (names often end in -gliflozin) pass sugar out in the urine. Watch for genital and urinary infections, dehydration, and warning signs such as vomiting, belly pain, extreme tiredness or fast breathing.

questions.label_zh: 現在有沒有意識模糊、抽搐，或血糖太高或太低，需要別人幫忙處理？
questions.label_en: Right now, are you confused, having a seizure, or with blood sugar so high or low that you need someone to help you?

rules.reason_zh: 請立刻撥 119 或到急診。
rules.reason_en: This may be a blood sugar emergency. Call 119 or go to the emergency room now.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有噁心、嘔吐、肚子痛、非常疲倦或呼吸急促？即使血糖不高也一樣。
questions.label_en: Do you have nausea, vomiting, belly pain, extreme tiredness or fast breathing, even if your blood sugar is not high?

rules.reason_zh: 噁心、嘔吐、肚子痛、非常疲倦或呼吸急促，需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫，並告訴醫師您在吃這個藥。
rules.reason_en: Nausea, vomiting, belly pain, extreme tiredness or fast breathing need immediate attention. Seek care now and tell the doctor you take this medicine.

questions.label_zh: 有沒有私密處搔癢、紅腫、分泌物，或排尿灼熱疼痛？

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，白天有沒有每週超過 2 次的氣喘症狀？

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，需要用急救型（緩解）吸入劑的次數有沒有每週超過 2 次？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did you need your reliever inhaler more than twice a week?

rules.reason_zh: 急救用藥偏多，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Frequent reliever use; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 最近 4 週，有沒有因為氣喘而影響日常活動？
questions.label_en: In the past 4 weeks, did asthma limit your activities?

rules.reason_zh: 活動受限，氣喘可能控制不佳，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Activity limitation; asthma may not be well controlled. The doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 過去一年內，有沒有因為氣喘發作而需要口服類固醇、掛急診或住院？
questions.label_en: In the past year, did an asthma attack need oral steroids, an ER visit or hospital admission?

rules.reason_zh: 過去一年有嚴重發作，是日後再發作的風險因子，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: A severe attack in the past year is a risk factor for future attacks; the doctor should review.

classes.summary_zh: 這類藥（如 cetirizine、fexofenadine）緩解過敏症狀；要留意嗜睡，以及症狀控制不佳或有嚴重過敏的警訊。
classes.summary_en: These medicines (such as cetirizine and fexofenadine) ease allergy symptoms. Watch for drowsiness, poor control, and signs of a severe allergy.

questions.label_zh: 過敏發作時，有沒有喘不過氣、喉嚨緊或臉、嘴唇腫起來？
questions.label_en: During an allergic reaction, have you had trouble breathing, a tight throat, or swelling of the face or lips?

rules.reason_zh: 喘不過氣、喉嚨緊，或臉、嘴唇腫起來，需要馬上處理，請立刻就醫。
rules.reason_en: Trouble breathing, a tight throat, or a swollen face or lips need immediate attention. Seek care now.

questions.label_zh: 吃了之後會不會很想睡、影響開車或工作？
questions.label_en: Does it make you very sleepy or affect driving or work?

rules.reason_zh: 嗜睡影響生活，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Drowsiness is affecting daily life; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 吃藥之後，過敏症狀（鼻水、打噴嚏、癢）還是很困擾您嗎？
questions.label_en: Even on the medicine, are allergy symptoms (runny nose, sneezing, itching) still bothering you a lot?

rules.reason_zh: 症狀仍然困擾您，請醫師確認。
rules.reason_en: Symptoms are still bothering you; the doctor should review.

questions.label_zh: 除了過敏症狀，有沒有喘鳴或胸悶？
questions.label_en: Besides allergy symptoms, do you have wheezing or chest tightness?

rules.reason_zh: 可能合併氣喘，請先回診評估。
rules.reason_en: This may include asthma; please visit first.
